title: beforeSearch hook for SearchBox component
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
Feature

**Feature: What is your use case for such a feature?**
I saw a similar thing here,
https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/823

**Feature: What is your proposed API entry? The new option to add? What is the behavior?**
Could be
```js
this.props.modifyRefine = refine => newRefine
```

**What project are you opening an issue for?**
- react-instantsearch

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**
3.1.0

comments.body:
Hi @vinhlh 

Can you tell us what particular use case you are interested in that'll need this feature?

Thanks!

@vvo Yes I guess we could have a refine hook that let's you decide to debounce or throttle when you need to. 
It could be at the InstantSearch level, but then you need a way to distinguish where does the event come from, so it might not be that easy to use comparing to a per widget hook.

React InstantSearch has been moved here: https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch
This issue has either been rewritten or placed inside our backlog.
